notes: Evals cover: (1) dispatch - instance lifecycle ops (create/init/update/run-tests/drop/ensure-up/status/load-language) route to odoo-instance (EN + VI); (2) anti-collision boundary vs odoo-coding (write code), odoo-debug (diagnose a runtime failure), odoo-solution-design (design before code), and the interactive /odoo-setup wizard (human declare-and-spinup); (3) the L2 human gate on mutations; (4) callers that NEED an instance but route to their own front door (e.g. translate -> odoo-i18n, which itself provisions via odoo-instance); (5) the single-owner boundary - instance fan-out always goes through odoo-instance in one of its two modes (dispatch mode when the caller can spawn; inline leaf-mode when a dispatched leaf/subagent self-provisions), and a leaf must NEVER cold-spawn the raw odoo-instance-ops agent nor call allocator.py directly to bypass the HARD RULES. Each case has a precise expected_behavior so it can fail for the right reason.

evals.prompt: create a v17 instance and install sale_custom + stock_custom on it
evals.expected_behavior: Skill fires; gathers operation=create/init, series=17.0, modules; L2 human gate before the mutation; launches odoo-instance-ops; returns a structured instance-ops block.
evals.must_not: Write module code or design anything; bypass the L2 gate.

evals.prompt: run the tests for the account module on my running instance
evals.expected_behavior: Skill fires; operation=run-tests (reuse vs fresh resolved from handle), dispatches odoo-instance-ops, returns log path + result.
evals.must_not: Author or fix tests (that is odoo-test-writing / odoo-coding).

evals.expected_behavior: Skill fires; operation=drop; L2 human gate confirms the destructive op before launching odoo-instance-ops.

evals.prompt: dung instance Odoo 17 roi cai module chay test
evals.expected_behavior: Vietnamese create+init+run-tests intent. Skill fires; L2 gate; dispatches odoo-instance-ops.
evals.must_not: Route to odoo-coding or skip the gate.

evals.prompt: nap ngon ngu vi_VN vao instance dang chay
evals.expected_behavior: Vietnamese load-language intent. Skill fires; operation=load-language via odoo-instance-ops.
evals.must_not: Confuse with odoo-i18n module translation (this only activates the locale on the instance).

evals.prompt: just spawn the odoo-instance-ops agent to spin up a database for me
evals.expected_behavior: Routes through odoo-instance, the single owner of instance fan-out; an orchestrator caller uses dispatch mode (launches odoo-instance-ops) enforcing the L2 gate + instance-allocation + HARD RULES before launching the agent.
evals.must_not: Launch odoo-instance-ops as a raw agent bypassing odoo-instance.

evals.prompt: you are a dispatched leaf coder with no INSTANCE_HANDLE and you need a DB to run --test-enable - get one
evals.expected_behavior: Leaf self-provisions by invoking Skill(odoo-instance) inline-mode, which acquires an isolated ephemeral DB UNDER the HARD RULES (en_US union, to_base, lint-module install, cli_help grounding) inline in the leaf's own context - no subagent spawned.
evals.must_not: Cold-spawn the raw odoo-instance-ops agent from the leaf, or call scripts/lib/allocator.py directly (bypassing the HARD RULES).

evals.prompt: write the compute method for this new field
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT fire odoo-instance - authoring code is odoo-coding, not instance lifecycle.
evals.must_not: Fire odoo-instance for a code-writing request.

evals.prompt: the server throws an Expected singleton error when I confirm the order - figure out why
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT fire odoo-instance - diagnosing a runtime failure to a root cause is odoo-debug.
evals.must_not: Fire odoo-instance for a runtime-diagnosis request.

evals.prompt: translate the sale module into Vietnamese
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT fire odoo-instance directly - translation routes to odoo-i18n, which itself provisions the needed instance via the odoo-instance skill.
evals.must_not: Fire odoo-instance directly for a translation request.

evals.prompt: walk me through setting up Odoo for the first time with the guided wizard and write my instances.toml
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT fire the odoo-instance skill - interactive human declare-and-spinup with instances.toml is the /odoo-setup command; odoo-instance is the programmatic path for callers who already know the parameters.
evals.must_not: Fire the odoo-instance skill for the interactive first-time wizard.
